articles.summary: BlindPay (YC W25) announces an investment from Circle Ventures to accelerate its USDC-powered infrastructure and connect the world's payment systems through one API.
articles.title: BlindPay Expands Global Stablecoin Payment Infrastructure with Circle Ventures

articles.summary: Blind Pay, LLC (YC W25) has received approval for its first U.S. state Money Transmitter License (MTL) from New Jersey, with 25 MTL applications submitted across the United States.
articles.title: BlindPay Receives Approval for Its First U.S. State Money Transmitter License
